edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Hom. in Cant. I, 7

source_text: Filii matris meae pugnaverunt adversum me. Considerandum, quomodo sponsa dicat: Filii matris meae pugnaverunt adversum me et quando adversum eam fratrum pugna surrexit. Vide mihi Paulum ecclesiae persecutorem et intelleges, quomodo filius matris eius pugnaverit contra eam. Persecutores ecclesiae egerunt paenitentiam et adversarii eius rursum ad sororis signa conversi praedicaverunt fidem, quam ante destruebant. Hoc prophetico spiritu sponsa nunc cantans ait: Dimicaverunt in me, posuerunt me custodem in vineis; vineam meam non custodivi. Ego ecclesia, ego sponsa, ego sine macula, plurimarum custos sum posita vinearum a filiis matris meae, qui contra me aliquando pugnaverant. Qua sollicitudine curaque districta dum plures custodio vineas, meam vineam non servavi. Intellege mihi hoc de Paulo et alio quocumque sanctorum, qui pro omnium sit salute sollicitus, et videbis, quomodo suam vineam non custodiens aliorum vineta custodiat.
pass_a_gloss: Sons of-mother of-me fought against me. Consider how / when brothers' fight arose. See Paul persecutor of-church — son of her mother fought against her. Persecutors did penance; adversaries turned to sister's standards preached faith they were-destroying. Bride sings: They-fought in me; they-set me keeper in vineyards; vineyard of-me I-did-not keep. Held by care of many vineyards, own vineyard not guarded. Understand of Paul and any saint anxious for all — not keeping own, keeps others' vineyards.
notes: Pass A literalist gloss ≠ Pass B literary English.

pass_b_english: [[My mother’s sons fought against me >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:6]]. We must consider how the Bride says, My mother’s sons fought against me, and when the brothers’ fight rose against her. Look at Paul, the persecutor of the Church, and you will understand how a son of her mother fought against her. The Church’s persecutors did penance, and her adversaries, turned again to the sister’s standards, preached the faith they had once been destroying. In this prophetic spirit the Bride now sings: They fought in me; they set me as a keeper in the vineyards; [[my own vineyard I have not kept >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:6]]. I the Church, I the Bride, I without spot, have been set as keeper of many vineyards by my mother’s sons, who once fought against me. Held by that anxious care, while I keep many vineyards I have not guarded my own. Understand this of Paul and of any other of the saints who is anxious for the salvation of all, and you will see how, not keeping his own vineyard, he keeps the vineyards of others.
